content: { "rules": [ "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias that corrects within 1-2 day horizons", "Sentiment turning from negative to positive (0 → 1) correlates with model undershooting the 1-3 day recovery, suggesting delayed sentiment response", "When sentiment is persistently positive (all 1.00), model forecasts align better with outcomes, indicating sentiment homogeneity simplifies prediction", "Mean reversion bias exists as model prices drift toward historical means (≈78.50) while true prices continue trending upward from volatility", "Large forecast-true outcome divergences (10-15%) occur at sentiment regime changes, particularly when moving from low to high sentiment", "Model underestimates price volatility by ~10-15% compared to true outcomes, especially when sentiment fluctuates rapidly", "When price history shows clear upward momentum, model forecasts lag behind true prices by 0.3-0.5 on average" ] }
